title: Chat room
statementMd:
Vasya has recently learned to type and log on to the Internet. He immediately entered a chat room and decided to say hello to everybody. Vasya typed the word $*s*$. It is considered that Vasya managed to say hello if several letters can be deleted from the typed word so that it resulted in the word "`hello`". For example, if Vasya types the word "`ahhellllloou`", it will be considered that he said hello, and if he types "`hlelo`", it will be considered that Vasya got misunderstood and he didn't manage to say hello. Determine whether Vasya managed to say hello by the given word $*s*$.

## Input

The first and only line contains the word $*s*$, which Vasya typed. This word consisits of small Latin letters, its length is no less that 1 and no more than 100 letters.

## Output

If Vasya managed to say hello, print "`YES`", otherwise print "`NO`".
statementZhMd:
Vasya 最近学会了打字并登录互联网。他立即进入了一个聊天室，并决定向大家问好。Vasya 输入了单词 $*s*$。如果可以从输入的单词中删除若干个字母，使其变成单词 `hello`，就认为 Vasya 成功地问了好。例如，如果 Vasya 输入单词 `ahhellllloou`，则认为他成功地问了好；而如果他输入 `hlelo`，则认为 Vasya 被误解了，没有成功问好。请根据给定的单词 $*s*$ 判断 Vasya 是否成功地问了好。

## 输入格式

第一行且仅有一行包含单词 $*s*$，即 Vasya 输入的单词。该单词由小写拉丁字母组成，长度不少于 1 且不超过 100。

## 输出格式

如果 Vasya 成功地问了好，输出 `YES`，否则输出 `NO`。
